description: A warm, calm man in his forties with a gentle, resonant baritone voice. He is a native Italian speaker with a natural standard Italian accent. He prays aloud sincerely at a natural, unhurried conversational pace, with natural intonation, reverent but not slow and not theatrical.
ref_text: Gloria al Padre e al Figlio e allo Spirito Santo. Come era nel principio, e ora e sempre, nei secoli dei secoli. Amen.
